#!audit-scan-lessons-corpus v1
#
# The lessons corpus for audit-scan.py --self-test. Each MUST line must fire its named
# class through the SAME predicates the scanner runs; each MUSTNOT must fire nothing.
# The magic first line declares this file test data, so the durable-write scanner
# reports it as SKIPPED rather than auditing it -- visibly, never silently excluded.
#
# Why this exists (obs 0050): a deterministic scanner's zero is only a finding when the
# scanner can be shown to fire. A class whose vocabulary rots must turn --self-test
# non-zero, so "0 candidates" cannot masquerade as "no lessons happened".
#
# Format: "MUST <class> :: <text>" / "MUSTNOT :: <text>"; blank lines and # ignored.

MUSTNOT :: ran the suite in parallel: 1043 passed, 113 skipped, budget reset at midnight
MUSTNOT :: the marker file was refreshed and the digest matches the published manifest
#

# carry the same correction signal as contradiction-shaped ones. Mid-turn messages arrive as
# queue-operation records, not last-prompt records — see lessons-scenarios/.
